_help: Put your files in the same folder as this labels.json (packages/filevora/test/calibration-files/, gitignored).
Every file there becomes an asset. You only have to write queries.
text is what a user would type. relevant lists the file names that should be found. Use [] when nothing should be found.
assets is optional. Add an entry only to write a description yourself; leave short, long, or tags out to have Gemini generate them once (cached in descriptions.cache.json).
Reading the result: in the printed top 5 per query, + means the file is in relevant and - means it is not. 'missed in top 10' lists relevant files that ranked lower.

queries.text: how much do we owe the supplier

assets.short: Optional. Written here, it replaces the generated description.
assets.long: Optional. Leave short, long and tags out to generate them with Gemini once.
